args.text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?

@gideon.sato For the postmortem, from this channel's history: your first report of the kiosks offline was 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, which said both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. In the meantime, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard, per your 10:42 message. Mateo reported kiosk 1 back at 11:03 AM, with the guard checking in trailer 8836 and dispatch seeing it. You reported both lanes working at 11:07 AM. The clipboard detail comes only from your 10:42 message, and nothing else in the channel describes the guard's activity.
